headline: Not Following Taiwan Stock Decline, NT Dollar Rises Instead on Three Factors - Finance
summary: On the 8th, the NT dollar moved higher while the Taiwan stock index sold off, closing down more than 200 points. Drivers cited include continued US dollar weakness and a sharp rise in the yen.
why: The New Taiwan dollar's direction affects Taiwan's exporters and foreign investors holding local equities.
why_moved: The NT dollar rose on continued US dollar weakness, a sharp yen rally lifting Asian currencies, and foreign inflows, while stocks sold off.
